Requirement: The system shall allow the user to define a label for a formbuilder component added to a form
The system shall allow the user to define a placeholder for a formbuilder component added to a form
The system shall allow the user to define the number of rows for a formbuilder component added to a form
The system shall allow the user to define selectable options for a formbuilder component added to a form
The system shall allow the user to select an Enlil item from the set category for a formbuilder component added to a form
The system shall allow the user to define and select a from a set of description options for a formbuilder component added to a form
The system shall allow the user to define a URL for a formbuilder component added to a form
The system shall allow the user to choose a form for a formbuilder component added to a form
The system shall allow the user to define the range for a Text Field with Range component added to a form
The system shall allow the user to select the critical to quality option for a formbuilder component added to a form
The system shall allow the user to select the inspection option for a formbuilder component added to a form
The system shall allow the user to add a selectable “Other” option for a formbuilder component added to a form
The system shall allow the user to add the “None” option for a formbuilder component added to a form
The system shall allow the user to select multiple options in a formbuilder component added to a form
The system shall allow the user to include a QR scan in a formbuilder component added to a form
The system shall allow the user to define an Inspection section in a formbuilder component added to a form
The system shall allow the user to choose to disable revision of a released form when the revision disabled checkbox is selected

The system shall allow the user to set the component to deletion disabled = true. Any enlil object created using a form with this component will disable the removal of that component even if the output type supports schema changes.
The system shall allow values entered in the output object of a form to be duplicated to a clone of that object when the Copyable value checkbox is selected in the form.
The system shall allow the user to add notes to the output object of a form when the include notes checkbox is selected

The user shall define if the control will be: (a) When “validation is true” then it is Flagged with the indicator that it is required; (b) When “validation is true” then it is Disabled when the textbox control is not required; (c) When “validation is true” then it is Hidden when the textbox control is not required
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to set a rule that will flag the formbuilder component if no data is entered
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to set a rule that will flag the formbuilder component if another field is equal to a specific value.
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to set a rule that will flag the formbuilder component if a different linked checkbox group field matches multiple pre-specified values

The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to set a rule that will flag the formbuilder component if a different linked field has any value. (eg. if field A linked to field B has any value, field B on which this rule is implemented needs to have some value)

The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to set a rule that will flag the field if a different linked field is blank. (eg. if field A linked to field B is blank, field B on which this rule is implemented needs to have some value)

If an applicable option is selected for the Dropdown in an Autocomplete field, a required flag is displayed if the specified document status is not selected. Note: This rule/ scenario applies only to the Autocomplete component

If "Document Revision" is selected from the dropdown in an Autocomplete field, a required flag is displayed if the specified document type is not selected. Note: This rule/ scenario applies only to the Autocomplete component. It is not applicable to any other component, or to other dropdown options within the Autocomplete component
